concerns.text: The plan states it will use computed geometric transport proxies (surface area, pore volume) as the target variable because no verified experimental permeability data exist. This directly violates FR‑016, which requires the target to be experimental permeability from a peer‑reviewed, publicly available source, and also breaches Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) by fabricating target values.

The plan’s sensitivity analysis uses distance thresholds {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} nm, while the specification (FR‑007, SC‑004) mandates sweeping {0.30, 0.50, 0.70} nm. This inconsistency means the plan will not satisfy the functional requirement or the associated success criteria.
